description: Score neurology & cognitive outcome scales (UMSARS/UPDRS/MDS-UPDRS/ADAS-Cog/MoCA/MMSE). Returns total + subscale scores, MCID-based responder classification, and trajectory comparison vs NNIPPS/PPMI/ADNI reference cohorts. Integrates with jca_pico_scope for MSA (neurology_msa, orphan Phase 2 2028)/PD (neurology_pd)/AD (neurology_ad) indication categories.

baseline_items.description: Optional: baseline scores for change-from-baseline and responder analysis.

compare_cohort.description: Natural-history reference cohort for trajectory comparison. nnipps=MSA, ppmi=PD, adni=AD.

items.description: Per-item scores. Supply all items for complete scoring, or a subset for partial scoring with a note.

item_id.description: Item identifier within the part, e.g. '1', '2', ...'12'

score.description: Item score (range depends on scale and item)

scale.description: Clinical outcome scale: umsars | updrs | mds_updrs | adas_cog | moca | mmse

time_point_months.description: Time point in months from baseline (used for trajectory comparison).

name: evidence.clinical_scale
